parameters.help_en:

parameters.help_en: The periodic check time
parameters.help_zh: 周期检测时间
parameters.name: cycle_days

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the check time period, which indicates the hour of the day. The start time and end time must be selected from the following time intervals. Valid values: 0, 6, 12, and 18.

0~6: If the start time is 0, the end time must be set to 6 on the same day.
6~12: If the start time is 6, the end time must be set to 12 on the same day.
12~18: If the start time is 12, the end time must be set to 18 on the same day.
18~24: If the start time is 18, the end time must be set to 24 on the same day
parameters.help_zh:
检查时间段开始时间，表示每天几点。 查询的开始时间和结束只能在以下时间区间中选择。取值：0、6、12、18。

0~6：当开始时间为0时，结束时间需要设置为当日6时。
6~12：当开始时间为6时，结束时间需要设置为当日12时。
12~18：当开始时间为12时，结束时间需要设置为当日18时。
18~24：当开始时间为18时，结束时间需要设置为当日24时
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the check time period, which indicates the hour of the day. The start time and end time must be selected from the following time intervals. Valid values: 6, 12, 18, and 24.

0~6: If the start time is 0, the end time must be set to 6 on the same day.
6~12: If the start time is 6, the end time must be set to 12 on the same day.
12~18: If the start time is 12, the end time must be set to 18 on the same day.
18~24: If the start time is 18, the end time must be set to 24 on the same day
parameters.help_zh:
检查时间段结束时间，表示每天几点。 查询的开始时间和结束只能在以下时间区间中选择。取值：6、12、18、24。

0~6：当开始时间为0时，结束时间需要设置为当日6时。
6~12：当开始时间为6时，结束时间需要设置为当日12时。
12~18：当开始时间为12时，结束时间需要设置为当日18时。
18~24：当开始时间为18时，结束时间需要设置为当日24时
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The start time of the check, in seconds from 00:00:00 of the current day. Valid values: 0 to 86399, which correspond to 00:00:00 to 23:59:59. This parameter is optional. If this parameter is not provided, the current value of the policy is retained. This parameter must be paired with EndTimeSeconds. If only one of them is provided, the system returns IllegalParam (paramName=scheduleTime). If both this parameter and StartTime/EndTime are provided, the second-level parameters take precedence, and the hour-level parameters are ignored. If the two sets of parameters are inconsistent, the server records a WARN log. The time window span must not be less than 60 seconds. The frequency of the system default policy (ConfigId=default) is always 6HOURLY. This parameter is not accepted for the default policy and will be rejected if provided. Under a multi-policy frequency, the actual scan execution time is exactly the second specified by this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 检查开始时间，自当日 00:00:00 起的秒数，取值范围 0-86399（对应 00:00:00-23:59:59）。可选参数，不传时保持策略当前值。与 EndTimeSeconds 必须成对传入，只传其中一个返回 IllegalParam（paramName=scheduleTime）。与 StartTime/EndTime 同时传入时以秒级为准，小时级参数被忽略，两者不一致时服务端记录 WARN 日志。时间窗跨度不得小于 60 秒。系统默认策略（ConfigId=default）频率恒为 6HOURLY，不接受本参数，传入将被拒绝。多策略频率下的实际扫描执行时刻恰好等于本参数指定的那一秒
parameters.name: start_time_seconds

parameters.help_en: The end time of the check, in seconds from 00:00:00 of the current day. Valid values: 1 to 86400, where 86400 indicates 00:00:00 of the next day. This parameter is optional. If this parameter is not provided, the current value of the policy is retained. This parameter must be paired with StartTimeSeconds. If only one of them is provided, the system returns IllegalParam (paramName=scheduleTime). If both this parameter and StartTime/EndTime are provided, the second-level parameters take precedence, and the hour-level parameters are ignored. The time window span must not be less than 60 seconds. This parameter is not accepted for the system default policy (ConfigId=default) and will be rejected if provided
parameters.help_zh: 检查结束时间，自当日 00:00:00 起的秒数，取值范围 1-86400（86400 表示次日 00:00:00）。可选参数，不传时保持策略当前值。与 StartTimeSeconds 必须成对传入，只传其中一个返回 IllegalParam（paramName=scheduleTime）。与 StartTime/EndTime 同时传入时以秒级为准，小时级参数被忽略。时间窗跨度不得小于 60 秒。系统默认策略（ConfigId=default）不接受本参数，传入将被拒绝
parameters.name: end_time_seconds
